changelog:
- Initial release of the "Global" skill, providing updates on cross-border e-commerce trends, international finance, overseas real estate, and immigration policies.
- Introduced filtering options by distance, popularity, and spending level.
- Added support for live queue status, booking channels, business hours, parking, and navigation details.
- Integrated community content: real photo galleries, shop reviews, and summary lists.
- Flexible update frequency based on geographic changes and review trends.
- Included usage examples and practical tips for users.
